comparison.objective: Load a primed IV set into a pump by seating the upper fitment first and then the safety clamp.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed fitment alignment, deformable-line management, force-controlled clamp insertion, and twist/stretch avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Fitment and clamp meet pose tolerances in the required dependency, tubing remains unstretched and untwisted, and hands clear for 2 seconds.
comparison.reason: This tests coupled insertion of two fittings connected by soft tubing. The candidate tests rigid-body screening, retention, agitation, and support replacement. No comparison-critical detail is missing.
